articleTitle: Path Planning Using an Improved A-star Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: There has been a heated issue in the field of robotics about how to plan the shortest path of a map with obstacles. This papers mainly analysis the issues about the path planned are not the shortest path by the A-star algorithm under certain conditions. An effective method is proposed which is called an improved A-star algorithm. The improved A-star algorithm is proposed to solve path planning under certain conditions, which can find a shorter path in contrast of other related methods. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithms are effective to settle above the issue, in which the path generated by the improved A-star algorithm has a shorter path than the path of other improved A-star algorithms.

articleTitle: A Fast Path Planning Algorithm Fusing PRM and P-Bi-RRT
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The path planned by the rapidly expanding random tree (RRT) algorithm is tortuous and the planning speed of RRT algorithm is slow. The path planning failure rate of the probabilistic roadmap (PRM) algorithm is high in complex scenarios. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a fusion algorithm fusing PRM and probability-based bidirectional RRT (P-Bi-RRT), which divides the planning area into two areas on average, and uses the PRM algorithm with faster planning speed for path pre-planning in each area, and then selects a node in each of the two areas to form a pair of optimal matching-points. The optimal matching-points is used to connect the two regional paths with the P-Bi-RRT algorithm or method of barrier-free direct connection. Finally, the planned path is optimized twice, the redundant nodes are trimmed and the path length is shortened. After a large number of simulation experiments, it is shown that the time of path planning is reduced by about 71% to 80%, the number of nodes is reduced by 70% to 80%, and the path length is shortened by 20% to 30% compared with the RRT algorithm.

articleTitle: Open-circuit Fault Diagnosis Based on 1D-CNN for Three-phase Full-bridge Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The inverter is one of the most important parts of the motor driver system which also the weak link prone to failure. Its reliability and stability are critical to the smooth operation of the motor drive system and the entire system. By performing fault diagnosis on the detection of the inverter and appropriate treatment in time, the reliability of the motor drive system can be greatly improved. The traditional fault diagnosis method has the problems of low fault recognition rate and long recognition time. A novel fault diagnosis method based on one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) for three-phase full-bridge inverter is proposed, which combines the two parts of adaptive fault feature extraction and fault classification into one. The fast Fourier transform (FFT) is used to convert the three-phase current signals into an amplitude spectrum. The signal is divided into training sets and testing sets. The training sets is used to train the weights and bias of the 1D-CNN, and the testing sets is used to check the accuracy of the network classification. In the final experiment, the effectiveness of this network was proved by comparison with Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Stacked Denoising Auto Encoder (SDAE). Experiments show that the diagnostic accuracy of 1D-CNN is better than 99.21%, which is significantly higher than that of MLP and SDAE. 1D-CNN will have better development prospects in the sphere of fault diagnosis, which can set a good foundation for the Prognostics Health Management (PHM) technology of power electronic systems.

articleTitle: Multiple Sensors Fault Diagnosis for Rolling Bearing Based on Variational Mode Decomposition and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The reliability of mechanical equipment is very important for the security operation of large-scale equipment. This paper presents a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). This proposed method includes using VMD and CNN to extend multi-sensor data, extracting detailed features and achieve more robust sensor fusion. Representative features can be extracted automatically from the raw signals. The proposed method can extract features directly from data without prior knowledge. The effectiveness of this method is verified on Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) dataset. Compared with one sensor and traditional approaches using manual feature extraction, the results show the superior diagnosis performance of the proposed method. Because of the end-to-end feature learning ability, this method can be extended to other kinds of sensor mechanical fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: LSTM-GAN-XGBOOST Based Anomaly Detection Algorithm for Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Time series anomaly detection is an important and fundamental task of Prognostic and Health Management (PHM). Traditional anomaly detection algorithms can achieve the detection of shallow features when dealing with the nonstationary time series data, yet those algorithms fail to detect outliers on deep features of massive time series data. In this paper, we proposed a novel fusion algorithm named LSTM-GAN-XGBOOST based on the characteristics of artificial neural networks (ANNs) and ensemble learning (EL). The hybrid approach combines long short-term memory network (LSTM) to extract time dimensional features of time series data, generative adversarial networks (GAN) to extract deep features of normal data effectively, and extreme gradient boosting (XGBOOST) to classify the extracted features and export anomaly scores. Moreover, we proposed an anomaly detection framework of test and evaluation based on LSTM-GAN-XGBOOST to obtain the final anomaly results and evaluation indicators. The proposed algorithm shows obvious advantages in processing features extraction and anomaly detection of time series data. Experimental and classic ball bearing time series datasets have been used to testify the effectiveness of the proposed approach and its superiority over some conventional methods. The experimental results demonstrate that LSTM-GAN-XGBOOST can effectively detect the anomalies of ball bearing time series dataset, and achieves 99.1% in terms of area under ROC curve (AUC) which is a superior performance compared with conventional algorithms, and has high significance for time series anomaly detection.

articleTitle: Few-shot Learning for Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Via Siamese Two-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Data-driven approaches such as deep learning have made great achievements in the field of fault diagnosis. However, most deep learning models acquire a large number of annotated samples to support their training. And for bearing fault detection, it is often difficult or even impossible to collect enough signals for each fault type. In this paper, we demonstrate how a few-shot learning method can be applied in fault diagnosis to lower the amounts of data required to make meaningful predictions. Specifically, we first use a Siamese two-dimensional convolutional neural network to extract the feature vectors of the input fault signal pairs. Second, the absolute difference (L1 distance) between the feature vectors is computed and then input to a fully connected layer with a sigmoid activation function to assess whether the input signal pairs belong to the same class. The Case Western Reserve University bearing data set is used to test the performance of the proposed method. Experimental results show that the proposed few-shot learning approach can obtain good accuracy when training samples are limited.

articleTitle: USV Obstacle Avoidance Based on Improved Watershed and VFH Method
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of unmanned surface vessel (USV), a real-time collision avoidance system is required to guarantee its safety navigation in the practical marine engineering. Therefore, this paper firstly uses wavelet transform technology to decompose and reconstruct the image collected by USV, so as to achieve the effect of denoising, and mark the foreground and background information. Then, the improved watershed segmentation method is used to segment the target object. Finally, a vector field histogram (VFH) method is proposed, which can solve the collision avoidance problem of USV from high dimension to low dimension based on the segmented image. The calculation burden is greatly low, and the real-time collision avoidance can be realized at the same time.

articleTitle: A Digital Twin Modeling Method for Turbofan Engine Real-time Test Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The turbofan engine is the main component of a power system in commercial aircraft, which provides thrust for the safe flight of the aircraft. The digital twin for the turbofan builds a virtual model corresponding to the real turbofan by using the operating mechanism, historical data, and real-time monitoring data. It can calculate multi-scale and high-fidelity data of turbofan engine in real-time and visually, and can also manage the turbofan engine data for the life cycle. One of the key functions of a digital twin is real-time test data analysis and performance monitoring. This paper realizes the key function by fusing the turbofan's mechanism model and the data-driven model. The verification with simulation data shows that the performance parameter monitoring error of the turbofan engine is within 20%.

articleTitle: Research on Verification of Sensor Fault Diagnosis Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Micro gas turbine technology is the core and key technology of energy and power systems in this century. Micro gas turbine generator sets have been widely used in distributed power generation systems and have become an important indicator of the advanced degree of national industrial foundation. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the distributed power generation system, the fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control research of the micro gas turbine are very important. This paper selects the TIOO single-axis micro gas turbine as the research object, designs a fault diagnosis method based on BP neural network for the failure of the sensor, and conducts the integrated verification of the model and algorithm on the full digital simulation platform.

articleTitle: Design of Vibration Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis System for Marine Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming at the high requirements of marine diesel engine safety operation, based on depth analysis of the requirement of vibration monitoring and fault diagnosis for marine diesel engine, a design scheme of vibration monitoring and fault diagnosis system for marine diesel engine is proposed from three aspects, including system architecture, hardware design and software design. According to the design scheme, a principle prototype is developed and verified through experiments. The experimental result shows that fault diagnosis and early warning can be realized by the principle prototype and disassembling the diesel engine is not required. The principle prototype is simply operation and highly reliability, which means the design scheme of vibration monitoring and fault diagnosis system is feasibility.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring System for Intelligent Slaughter Production Line Based on Internet of Things and Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: At present, the slaughter production line has problems such as low information level and high cost of downtime. This paper studies the visual status monitoring of sheep slaughter production lines based on industrial Ethernet and Internet of Things technology. The remote monitoring system of intelligent slaughter production line based on the Internet of Things and cloud platform is proposed and implemented in this paper. PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) at the production site collects real-time status data of the production equipment. The real-time status data are encapsulated in the form of MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) messages via the MQTT gateway and sends to the Alibaba Cloud IoT (Internet of Things) platform. The Alibaba Cloud IoT platform forwards the status data to the data analysis server of the cloud server to complete the analysis and storage of the data. Then realize remote status monitoring through the Web server. The test results show that all modules of the system can be consistent with the design requirements. The system runs stably and job data are monitored clearly which meets the need for industrial remote monitoring systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Diagnostic Scheme for Gear Pitting Fault Using Fiber Bragg Grating Based Strain Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The performance of gearbox vibration monitoring techniques may degrade due to the signal distortion and attenuation which is usually caused by the complicated transmission path. The fiber Bragg grating sensing technique has attracting characteristics such as the small size, multiple measurement points on one fiber and resistance to oil corrosion. Therefore, this paper proposes a new approach for online monitoring of gearboxes based on fiber Bragg grating based strain sensors, in which the fiber Bragg grating sensors can be mounted closely to the meshing position of gear teeth. In this study, the working principle of the fiber Bragg grating and the configuration of the test rig is firstly presented. Then, the tooth root dynamic strain signals measured by fiber Bragg gratings under the healthy and gear pitting conditions were presented and compared with the finite element simulations. The comparison between the measured and simulated signals agrees well, which validates the feasibility of the employment of fiber Bragg gratings for the online monitoring of gearboxes. Furthermore, a novel diagnostic algorithm based on dynamic time warping is proposed to process the measured signals using fiber Bragg grating based strain sensors. The results show the proposed algorithm is able to diagnose the healthy and gear pitting conditions without the need of the pre-measured baselines.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Wing Structure Health Monitoring Technology Based on Finite Element Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In order to solve the real-time health monitoring problem of the UAV wing structure, a wing monitoring method based on finite element simulation analysis and signal anomaly analysis is proposed. Firstly, CATIA software is used to perform full-scale three-dimensional modeling of the wing, and then FLUENT and ANSYS software are used for finite element simulation analysis of the wing and determine the fault monitoring nodes. On this basis, common faults are injected into the wing, and node data is collected at the same time, and Beacon Exception Analysis Method (BEAM) is used to perform fault detection on the data. The results prove that the method can accurately check the fault in real time and determine the location of the fault according to the node distribution and channel contribution rate, which provides an effective guarantee for improving the efficiency of UAV fault diagnosis and improving the flight safety of UAV.

articleTitle: Cross-Domain Fault Diagnosis Method for Rotating Machinery Based on Multi-Representation Adaptation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The success of the fault diagnosis method based on deep learning depends on two conditions: 1) The training and test data sets must come from the same data distribution. 2) A large amount of labeled data with fault information is required. However, the working environment of rotating machinery is usually harsh and complex, the speed and load will change constantly, and it is very difficult to obtain plenty of labeled data with fault information. To solve these problems, a cross-domain rotating machinery fault diagnosis method is proposed. Firstly, the vibration signal of time series is transformed into a time-frequency image by continuous wavelet transform. Then the multi-representation adaptation network model is used for cross-domain fault diagnosis. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by six transfer fault diagnosis tasks.

articleTitle: Model-based Systems Engineering for Prognostic and Health Management Design
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The methods of traditional system design are passed in document form, and it is difficult to trace back if the document changes or errors are found in the downstream design. Moreover, there is no systematic development guidance and design, which makes the designed model complex and simple, and makes model-driven simulation impossible, resulting in development progress slowly. In this paper, the PHM functional architecture of aircraft avionics system is studied by using the system engineering design concept based on model. Using HarmonySE method of system design and Rhapsody of tool model driver, the functional architecture of PHM system was designed.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis with Imbalanced Data Based on Auto-encoder
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In class imbalance problem, researchers proposed data-level and algorithm-level methods successively. However, we found the imbalance is usually accompanied by the problem of small samples. For example, in the case of few fault samples and many normal samples, we need to deal with both imbalance problem and small sample problem. Based on the influence mechanism of the imbalance on the algorithm, this paper proposes a novel neural network model for solving the class imbalance problem with small samples. By changing the feature extraction process of auto-encoder, we can extract vector features, while the standard auto-encoder can only extract scalar features. By stacking the new auto-encoder model, we can deeply mine the data characteristics and extract the diversified vector features to complete the fault diagnosis task. Vector features effectively improve the feature extraction ability of the model and reduce the sensitivity of the model to class imbalance. The proposed deep model is verified using two types of fault diagnosis datasets and compared with other methods. The results indicate that the proposed method significantly improves the fault diagnosis accuracy in the task with class imbalance and small samples.

articleTitle: The Method for Identifying Rotating Blade Asynchronous Vibration and Experimental Verification
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Based on the principle of blade tip timing (BTT) and the vibration principle of one degree of freedom, the parameter identification algorithm of rotating blade asynchronous vibration is established by using all phase FFT(apFFT) and least square method. The algorithm is verified by numerical simulation. The tests of asynchronous vibration parameter identification were launched on a fan rotor, while high pressure nitrogen was used to shock the blades to produce single frequency absolute occupancy vibration. Results show that the method for asynchronous vibration identification could accurately identify blade vibration parameters, and the vibration frequencies of all blades obtained are exactly the same. Frequency identification accuracy is high with the maximum relative error of 1.12% using strain analysis frequency as a baseline. Results verify that the method of asynchronous vibration parameter identification is correct.

articleTitle: Myocardial Infarction Localization and Blocked Coronary Artery Identification Using a Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Myocardial Infarction (MI) is a fatal heart attack that causes millions of death in the world every year and the mortality of this disease is extremely high. Therefore, the precise diagnosis and the instant alert of MI is vital for the patients in hospital. In this paper, we have provided a deep learning method using Lenet to determine whether there is MI in the patient and the necrosis region of MI, from which the model can also provide the prediction of the blocked coronary artery. The accuracy of the model using single lead of ECG independently can achieve more than 99% and even the precision, sensitivity and specificity can exceed more than 99%, which outperforms most of the algorithms.

articleTitle: The Application of Electromagnetic Induction Method in the Detection of Steel Bars Position in Reinforced Concrete Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The electromagnetic induction method is a common method used to detect the position of steel bars in reinforced concrete structure. Firstly, this paper explains the principle of the electromagnetic induction method to detect the position of steel bars through the phenomenon of electromagnetic induction. Secondly, according to the experimental operation and data analysis, the problems related to the detection of reinforcement position by electromagnetic induction method are discussed. Finally, the influencing factors of the accuracy of the electromagnetic induction method are analyzed, which can provide reference for the accurate use of the electromagnetic induction method.

articleTitle: Weak Faults Diagnosis for Rolling Bearings Based on Variational Hilbert Huang Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Vibration signal is the most used monitoring signal in fault diagnosis. However, the location of the sensor will be restricted in some special cases. Therefore, non-contact microphone sensors are often used in these cases, which may cause some problems. For example, acoustic signals are always the low signal-to-noise ratio signals, which are difficult to accurately detect faults. Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) is a powerful method for bearing fault diagnosis, which includes Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) and Hilbert Transform (HT). However, mode aliasing and redundant modes are common in empirical mode decomposition, which are bad for detecting bearing faults. Aiming at the disadvantages of HHT, the Variational-Hilbert-Huang Transform (VHHT) is proposed for weak bearing fault diagnosis. Firstly, the signal is decomposed into several intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) through EMD. Then sensitive IMFs, which are chosen through the sensitivity evaluation algorithm, are decomposed by variational mode decomposition (VMD) to obtain several limited bandwidth intrinsic mode function (LBIMFs). Next, LBIMFs are reorganized according to the signal characteristics to obtain the fault component. Finally, the bearing fault is detected by HT. The proposed method is verified by simulation and experimental signals, and compared with HHT and VMD. The results show that VHHT is more prominent in detecting faults in low SNR rolling bearing signals.

articleTitle: Early Fault Detection of Rolling Elememt Bearings Based on Visibility Graph Modeling of Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In this paper, the relevant information hidden in the frequency components of the vibration signal in the rolling element bearing (REB) is an important indicator of the REB status. In order to make better use of this information, visibility graph is introduced into REB failure analysis. The original signal is firstly converted into the time-frequency domain via short-time Fourier transform (STFT), and then the periodogram method is adopted to extract the power spectrum. Afterwards, visibility graph is utilized to model the power spectrum to extract relevant information between each frequency component. Next, anomaly score will be obtained based on specific distance metric. Finally, faults will be detected through a retrospective analysis method. The theory crafting and experiments implemented in a REB fault scenario have proved the feasibility and superiority of this method.

articleTitle: Analog Circuit Incipient Fault Diagnosis from Raw Signals using Multi-Layer Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Analog circuits play important roles in modern electronic systems. Incipient fault diagnosis of analog circuits is a recognized challenging research direction due to the difficulty of fault feature extraction and identification. This paper proposes an early fault diagnosis algorithm for analog circuits based on multilayer extreme learning machine (ML-ELM).Its basic idea comes from the Auto-encoder(AE) and the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM). The proposed method which combines the characteristics of both, so it has the ability of feature extraction and fast training speed. In this method, the time domain sampling signal of the circuit can be directly used as the fault sample, and the unsupervised feature extraction is carried out layer by layer through the deep network, the diagnosis results are obtained after the supervised classification by the traditional ELM algorithm. The whole process does not rely on multi-step iterative and reverses fine-tuning. The experimental results of the Sallen-Key band-pass filter circuit and Leapfrog low-pass filter circuit show that the method has not only high diagnosis accuracy, but also fast diagnosis speed. Because this method gets rid of the tedious manual feature extraction and complex signal processing, it improves the training efficiency and makes the method more universal.

articleTitle: Study on Engine Wear Position Based on Oil Monitoring and Grey Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Lubricating oil plays a role in reducing wear in the engine, with the increase of engine running time, metal particles generated from the friction between parts will enter the lubricating oil, resulting in oil degradation and damaging the viscose-temperature performance of the lubricating oil. However, viscosity-temperature performance is an important index of engine health. In this paper, the viscose-temperature performance of lubricating oil is monitored to analyze whether the equipment is in normal operation. In case of abnormal operation, monitor the concentration of wear particles in the lubricating oil, the metal particles with the largest correlation degree in lubricating oil were calculated by grey relational analysis method. According to the correlation degree of wear particles, find out the wear part of engine. This method can judge whether the equipment is running normally, and find out the wear parts in time, improve the reliability and operation efficiency of the equipment, and reduce the harmfulness of production safety accidents.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Buck Converter under Variable Operating Conditions Based on Optimal Fractional Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming at the fault of the buck converter caused by the parameter degradation of the electrolytic capacitor, a fault diagnosis method based on optimal fractional wavelet transform is proposed. Firstly, the output voltage of open-loop and closed-loop Buck converter under variable conditions is collected as fault signal. Then, particle swarm optimization is used to optimize the p value of fractional wavelet transform, and the fault signal is transformed into p-order fractional wavelet transform. The wavelet energy is extracted as fault feature to construct fault feature vector. Finally, SVM classifier is used for training and testing to realize fault diagnosis of buck converter. Experimental results show that the fault diagnosis method based on optimal fractional wavelet transform can effectively and accurately diagnose the faults of open-loop and closed-loop buck converters under variable operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Intermittent Fault Injection Strategy for Electronic Equipment Health Status Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In this paper, through the statistical analysis of the data of contact resistance changing with time when the circuit intermittent fault occurs, a model of intermittent fault is proposed, and an intermittent fault injector is built by the FPGA and high-speed programmable resistor, which use to inject the intermittent fault into the circuit, so as to carry out the research related to the intermittent fault. Then, the application of the intermittent fault injector is illustrated by an example of circuit health status recognition. In the example, intermittent fault injector is used to keep circuits in different health states, then FSV method is used to extract the feature of the fault, after training HSMM models, the health state of the circuit is identified. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by comparative experiments.

articleTitle: Model-based Simulation and Verification of Aircraft Prognostics and Health Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The development of AVPHM is introduced, the framework and VV&A process of aircraft PHM system are given. A model-based approach was used to build models of AVPHM systems, describing the characteristics of the system. Furthermore, the simulation tool is used to complete the iteration and integration of the models, which provides a method for the verification of the AVPHM system.

articleTitle: Health Assessment of Two-stage Inverter Based on Multiple Evaluation Indexes Feature Optimization Model and Mahalanobis Distance
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming to address the problem of the quantitative assessment of inverter health status, a novel method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the fault feature library of power electronic circuit is composed of time-domain, frequency-domain, time-frequency domain characteristics and circuit performance parameters. Then, the multiple evaluation indexes feature optimization model is used to optimize the fault characteristic parameters to obtain the circuit-level health characteristic parameters. Finally, the degradation evaluation of the circuit is carried out based on the Mahalanobis Distance and this scheme is verified by a 200VA two-stage single-phase inverter.

articleTitle: Complex Equipment Diagnostic Reasoning Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: To improve maintenance efficiency, accurate location of fault component has become one of important studied content in system or complex equipment. The essence of diagnostic reasoning is to establish the classification model of the product feature data and the location of faults. As one of effective machine learning algorithm, artificial neural network was widely used to solve classification problems. In this paper, diagnostic reasoning method based on neural network algorithm was researched. Firstly, a design framework of diagnostic reasoning based on neural network was proposed. Then, the method of data processing was studied, and a neural network architecture and algorithm for diagnostic reasoning was designed. In the last, a case study was presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of diagnostic reasoning algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Multi-scale Transfer Sample Entropy
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: To solve the defects that the generalization ability of the traditional data-driven fault diagnosis model reduces or even fails in mechanical system diagnosis, a multi-scale transfer sample entropy is proposed based on the idea of transfer learning. First, the multi-scale transfer sample entropy method is proposed to extract fault features based on multi-scale sample entropy and feature transfer learning. Second, the parameters of the multiscale transfer sample entropy method are optimized to further improve the fault identification accuracy. Finally, the experiment results of rolling bearing show that the proposed multi-scale transfer sample entropy can effectively improve the generalization ability of the data-driven model and realize the accurate identification of different fault locations of the rolling bearing under a small number of samples.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-channel EIS Measurement System for Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: As lithium-ion batteries are gradually applied to various energy storage environments, research on the health of lithium-ion batteries is becoming increasingly important. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) is a practical method for studying batteries, through which multiple health parameters of the battery can be obtained to evaluate the health status of the battery. This article mainly designs an eight-channel battery EIS measurement device for multiple lithium-ion batteries. In the static state of the system, eight lithium-ion batteries are connected to the Neware battery testing system, which can carry out charge and discharge experiments at the same time. After a battery channel is selected, EIS can be measured and the electrochemical impedance spectrum of the battery can be transmitted back to the host computer.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method of Rotating Machinery Based on Multi-scale Fuzzy Entropy
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The application of feature extraction method in bearing fault diagnosis plays an important role in industrial applications. In recent years, the bearing fault diagnosis methods had a very big development, the direction of the fault diagnosis of rotating machinery using the database aims to extract the features using multi-scale entropy. Then, KNN classification method is applied to classify five fault types of gearboxes. The proposed method can be a promising approach for fault diagnosis of rotating machinery.

articleTitle: Research on cigarette packet recognition and stacking technology based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In order to improve the automation and intelligence level of tobacco packet distribution and to automatically complete the stacking flow operation of tobacco packet, a set of automatic stacking robot systems based on machine vision were designed. This system includes the visual system and sorting palletizing system. In the visual system shape area, k-means clustering is adopted to establish the standard template library. A fast matching algorithm based on the shape of template was put forward, which could identify smoke a few shapes and cigarette package fast and accurately. Then the upper machine data information was sent to the palletizing system to finish the tobacco package, cigarette package group pile, and pallet cigarette packet scheduling algorithm of automatic palletizing homework. The field test results showed that the shape recognition rate of cigarette packs was over 99.90%, the shape matching time of cigarette packs was less than 80ms, the stacking efficiency was 5.04-5.14s per packet, the stacking tilt value was less than 3cm, the packing void rate was less than 5%, and the stacking error rate was less than 0.10%, which met the requirements of cigarette packing stacking. The system can provide technical support for improving tobacco logistics automation.

articleTitle: Health State Evaluation for Fuzzy Multi-state Production Systems based on MPNM
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: With the advent of Industry 4.0, modern production systems have obvious polymorphic characteristics. However, due to unpredictable external working conditions, modern manufacturing systems have obvious fuzzy characteristics. Therefore, this paper proposes a health state evaluation method for fuzzy multi-state production systems based on a multi-state production network model (MPNM). First, the definition of the health state of the fuzzy multi-state production system is given, which comprehensively analyzes the machine performance state and the output product quality state. Second, the multi-state production network model of a multistate production system is established, which is based on the operational characteristics of the production system. Third, the fuzzy Markov model is used as a tool to propose a health state assessment method for multi-state production systems. Finally, the ferrite phase shifting unit production system is taken as an example to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Injector in High Pressure Common Rail System of Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: As the core component of common rail system, high pressure common rail injector of diesel engine has a direct influence on fuel injection volume. However, it is difficult to distinguish the faults due to there are many fault types in injector. In this paper, a method for injector fault diagnosis is proposed. The injection volume is predicted by Gaussian Process Regression model according to the pressure of injector pressure chamber, then the fault classification is carried out by machine learning based on the time domain feature of the pressure curve when the injection volume is out of tolerance. The simulation results show that the method has high accuracy and provides a new idea for on-line fault diagnosis of fuel injector.

articleTitle: Analysis to Effect of Localized Defect Sizes on Bearing Vibration Response by Explicit Dynamic Finite Element Model
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In view of the different response of bearing system caused by the change of localized defect size on bearing outer ring, considering the shaft, pedestal and localized defect, a twodimensional (2-D) explicit dynamic Finite Element (FE) model is proposed. The results were analyzed and the FE model is verified. The effect of defect angle on simulated acceleration signals is explored in time domain and frequency domain. Utilizing the method of spline interpolation and polynomial fitting, when defect angle changes, the variation trend of the maximum of acceleration signals in time domain and the maximum of fault characteristic frequency component of acceleration in frequency domain, as well as its functional relationship are studied. Finally, this model can provide a theoretical guidance for bearing fault diagnosis based on vibration detection.

articleTitle: Detection of Material Surface Cracks by Infrared Non-destructive Testing
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: When cracks exist on the surface of the material, there are various risks during the use of the specimen. Surface crack is also an important reason for specimen failure and damage. In this paper, the surface crack of the material is studied by using infrared thermal image microscope and adopting the passive infrared detection which is different from the traditional active infrared detection. The cracks in different directions and sizes were found by qualitative analysis of the chromium plated stainless steel. Because the cracks in the test block were too small and the contrast was not high, Matlab software was used for image processing to improve the contrast. The length of defects was detected by introducing a scale for quantitative analysis of the iron block. The error of the test results was analyzed, and a new test method to reduce the error was designed. The results of the two methods are compared and analyzed, which show that the passive infrared thermal imaging microscope has the ability to detect the size and shape of defects.

articleTitle: Adaptive Multi-objective Particle Swarm optimization Based on Competitive Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In the evolutionary process of multi-objective optimization algorithm, the selection of the guide has a great influence on the flying state of particles. A more accurate guide selection strategy can enhance the convergence faculty and maintain the population's diversity. This article introduces an improved multi-objective optimization algorithm (AMPSO). Its core innovation is the introduction of competition. Firstly, the evolution process is divided into three states according to the different flight conditions of particles: convergence state, exploration state, and stagnation state. At the same time, the traditional g-best algorithm is divided into three kinds: c-gbst, d-gbest, and s-gbest. Then, according to the evolution state of particles, different leaders are selected. When the particles are in convergence state, c-gbest is selected as the leader to improve the convergence ability of the population. When the particles are in exploration state, d-gbest is selected as the leader to improve the diversity of particles. When the particles are in stagnation state, s-gbest is selected as the leader to guide the population out of the local area optimal. Compared with the other four modified multi-objective algorithms, we have carried out a series of experimental simulations of 10 benchmark functions. Experimental results reveal that the algorithm in this paper performs better.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Based on Domain-Adversarial Partial Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: With the successful application of deep learning, fault diagnosis of rotating machinery has a significant accuracy improvement. However, these methods based on deep learning need massive labeled samples for training, while it is quite difficult to obtain labeled fault data in the real scenario of engineering. Lacking labeled fault samples, many intelligent methods can not be applied to fault diagnosis. Fortunately, the classical datasets of rotary machines nearly contain all the common fault types. Moreover, transfer learning provides an alternative approach for fault diagnosis of rotating machinery under the situation of lacking labeled fault data. Therefore, a novel intelligent method based on domain-adversarial partial transfer learning is proposed in this paper for the settlement of the above problem, named DA-PTL. The proposed model consists of three parts: feature extractor, domain discriminator, and sample classifier. By transfer learning, the method can realize the fault diagnosis of the target bearings using an open bearing dataset and the gathered data of the target bearings. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can achieve a good result for fault diagnosis of rolling bearing that is a lack of massive labeled fault samples.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Hybrid Nonlinear Character Monitoring Approach For Compressor Blades Fault Diagnosis Using Blade Tip Timing Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Compressor blades which are exposed to harsh working conditions in turbine engines will suffer from varying damage and complex faults inevitably. Thus, monitoring the blade dynamic condition instantaneously and effectively is essential for detecting initial defects. As a prominent noncontacting measurement method, blade tip timing (BTT) is widely implemented in compressor blades vibration detection. The purpose of this study is to diagnose blade faults by obtaining nonlinear dynamic characters from BTT data. Firstly, nonlinear dynamic model for cracked rotating blades is built. Then blade vibration frequencies are extracted from BTT signals based on the sparse representation model. In addition, the relationship between the nonlinear dynamic response of blades and the vibration frequency is revealed. Finally, with the assistance of machine learning algorithms, blade damage degrees are classified combining with vibration frequency spectra and nonlinear characteristics. Numerical simulations are designed to verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Key Problems of Virtual Testability Demonstration Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Prognostics and system health management (PHM) performance mainly relies on the testability level of equipment. Testability demonstration is very important to verify and assess the testability index. The existing methods based on actual test have several disadvantages, such as lack of fault samples and irrationality of fault samples. The method of virtual testability demonstration which is based on digital twin technology maybe solve those problems. The development of the testability demonstration is summarized and the virtual testability-oriented modeling method is analyzed in this paper. The paper emphasizes the key technology parts in the virtual testability demonstration based on digital twin technology, including the testability-oriented modeling, the generation of fault sample, the test and diagnosis simulation based on digital twin. The methods and models proposed in the paper are of great application value in the testability demonstration and PHM. It also can help the designers to improve design schemes in design stage and truly achieve the integration of design.

articleTitle: Radar Solder Joint Monitoring Technology Based on Circuit Modeling and Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The demand for life-cycle management of weapons and equipment drives the research and development of radar fault prognostic and Health Management (PHM) technology. With the continuous development of information technology, digital circuits account for more and more of the radar due to their excellent reliability and stability. The digital circuit will be affected by the surrounding environmental stress (thermal stress and mechanical stress) in the process of use, which will cause deformation of printed circuit board and lead to the failure of the pin of the chip, and ultimately lead to the failure of the chip, which may lead to serious damage to the radar. The Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) chip, due to its Programmable characteristics and its important position in the digital circuit, we regard the monitoring of FPGA pin as the standard to judge whether the digital circuit communicates normally. In this paper, the damage of FPGA pin is monitored by means of solder joint-built in self test(sj-bist) and the monitoring circuit is designed by means of principle analysis and IP core design, and the monitoring results are analyzed quantitatively by circuit design. The simulation experiment is carried out by PSpice simulation software, and the feasibility of monitoring circuit design by sj-bist method is verified by circuit construction and simulation analysis. Finally, the influence of temperature and internal resistance on the monitoring accuracy is obtained through simulation experiment, and the monitoring results are modified through theoretical analysis to improve the monitoring accuracy of the sj-bist technology.

articleTitle: Affine Projection Spline Adaptive Filter for Nonlinear System Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: System identification for nonlinear system is an important field in practical engineering. Spline adaptive filter (SAF) is a kind of simple and effective nonlinear identification method used for online cases, which uses a flexible spline interpolation function to describe the complex nonlinearity in practice. In order to further improve the convergence behavior of the traditional SAF, an affine projection spline adaptive filter (APSAF) is proposed in this paper. Instead of using only one current sample during the process of parameter adaption, the proposed APSAF uses a series of historical samples (data block) for parameter adaption in each adaption loop. The historical data belonging to each interpolation interval are recorded during the filtering process. Utilizing more than one sample can significantly improve the convergence speed since there exists more gradient information during parameter adaption. An analysis of the APSAF performance is presented in this paper, and a numerical simulation is performed in order to verify the effectiveness of this algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed APSAF performs much better than traditional SAF algorithm in nonlinear system identification.

articleTitle: Design of Fault Diagnosis System for Steam Turbine Based on UML
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Intelligent fault diagnostic systems have become a new hotspot of research with the wave of intelligent manufacturing, effective modeling method is an important means to build a reliable diagnosis system. Aiming at the current problems such as the various system functions, complex structure and expansibility, a new method to model the fault diagnosis system of steam turbine with UML is presented. In this paper, the use case diagram, class diagram, function decomposition diagram, activity diagram, sequence diagram, and deployment diagram of steam turbine fault diagnosis system are constructed by UML, and the diagnosis process is described completely, which provides a development framework for developers. It is proved that the modeling method is reliable and effective by the development of the research group.

articleTitle: A Just-In-Time-Learning Based Data-driven Method for Valve Failure Prognostics
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: A just-in-time-learning based data-driven prognostic method is presented in this study to handle system nonlinearity due to multiple operating conditions and diversified degradation patterns. The proposed method adopts a just-in-time learning (JITL) scheme to select historical failure cases that demonstrate similar degradation patterns. A data-driven forecasting model called gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT) is employed to extract degradation features from the selected failure cases and predict system remaining useful life (RUL). The effectiveness of the proposed approach was validated on temperature measurements collected from 13 valve failure cases of an industrial reciprocating compressor.

articleTitle: Application of Grey System Model in Overtaking with High Benefit
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: This paper applies grey theory to predict high-efficiency overtaking in order to achieve effective overtaking prediction. Through the monitoring of overtaking data by electronic police, effective control of road network security is achieved. This model has a certain warning effect on the occurrence of large-scale overtaking, and has a certain guiding significance for the management and control of the road network and the elimination of hidden dangers. The overtaking phenomenon of the road network is affected by many factors and has the characteristics of high noise and multiple disturbances. Applying the GM (1,1) model in the gray system can effectively resist shock disturbance traps. According to the characteristics of high-efficiency overtaking data, small data is used for real-time modeling, and the model will constantly change according to time. This article uses GM (1,1) modeling, which has good performance in small data and high noise modeling, in order to achieve early warning of road overtaking control.

articleTitle: Research on Bearing Cross-domain Fault Diagnosis Based on Invariant Subspace Learning with Tensor Alignment
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Rolling bearings are very important in the research of fault diagnosis of rotating machinery. With the continuous development of big data technology, fault diagnosis has ushered in a data-driven era. This paper starts with high-dimensional rolling bearing fault data and proposes a tensor invariant subspace learning technique (TAISL). By converting the vibration signal formula into a third-order tensor in order to directly adapt the source domain and target domain in the case of tensor representation, the TAISL method is introduced into the tensor representation method to narrow the distance between the source domain and the target domain and then the 2DCNN method is used to identify bearing faults. Through experiments under various conditions, the proposed method was fully verified. The results show that the proposed method can effectively shorten the distance between different distributions reduce noise interference, and effectively classify fault samples even when the data distribution is inconsistent and the data dimension is high.

articleTitle: The Influence of Axial Temperature Distribution on Calibration Accuracy Based on Dry Block Furnace
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Dry block furnaces are widely used in on-site measurement and calibration of food, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, and other manufacturing enterprises. The accuracy of dry-block furnace temperature measurement has always been a problem for temperature calibrator. The research on the dry-block furnace mainly focuses on the stability measurement, the on-site temperature calibration method, the temperature distribution uniformity and so on. Therefore, the axial temperature distribution of dry-block furnace is an important factor affecting its accuracy. In this study, the dry-block furnace (Const 660 produced in China) is selected as the research object to study the relationship between calibration temperature and axial temperature distribution of dry well furnace by experimental method. The results found that from the bottom of the furnace to the wellhead side, the temperature probe insertion depth should be as close as possible to the bottom of the well, and the closer the calibration temperature is to the ambient temperature, the higher the accuracy of the temperature measurement. The study provides more comprehensive and reliable experimental data for the application of dry-block furnace in field temperature calibration, so as to improve the accuracy of temperature measurement and better application of dry block furnace.

articleTitle: The Gradual Reliability and Sensitivity Analysis of Gear Transmission System Considering Strength Degradation
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The gear transmission system is the most widely used transmission system and plays an important role in various fields. In order to reduce the serious consequences caused by sudden gear failure, a reliability model based on the life parameters of gear contact and bending strength through the theory and method of reliability robustness is established, and takes into account the inevitable strength degradation factors. Therefore, the gradual reliability of the gear is predicted more accurately. In addation, the sensitivity analysis of the parameters that affect the life of the gear is provided, which is of great significance to the optimal design of gears. It is concluded that, firstly, the failure mode and gradual reliability model of the gear are obtained under the corresponding working conditions; Secondly, the reliability model considering the strength degradation is more in line with the actual situation; Thirdly, the sensitivity analysis can find the sensitive design parameters of the gear, which has important engineering guidance significance for improving the overall reliability of the gear system, ensuring its working efficiency and reducing production costs.

articleTitle: Review on Remaining Useful Life Prediction Methods of Bearing
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: As the foundation and kernel point of prognostics and health management (PHM) technique, the prediction of remaining useful life (RUL) raises numerous concerns. Bearing is one of the momentous parts that determine the state of health and life of the wind turbines, high-speed trains, and rotating machines. With increasing application of bearing in the equipment, the research on RUL prediction of bearing has gradually become one of the issues concerned by people, the research on the RUL prediction methods has made some progress at home and abroad. This paper aims to summarize the research status of RUL prediction methods of the bearings in recently years. Furthermore, the RUL prediction methods of bearings are introduced, which includes RUL prediction methods based on statistical data-driven and RUL prediction methods based on machine learning (ML), and summarizes the research results of RUL prediction. Finally, the research on the RUL prediction method of bearing was prospected.

articleTitle: Establishment of Accelerated Degradation Model and Life Evaluation Method for External Coating of Airborne Radome under Ozone
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics that the airborne antenna will be subjected to severe ozone environment during use, the author proposes a method for establishing an accelerated degradation model of the outer coating of the radome in an ozone environment, and gives a corresponding life assessment method. Firstly, the author summarizes the ozone environment, ozone concentration extreme value and ozone change law at the cruising altitude of the military aircraft, secondly summarizes the aging effect and mechanism of the external coating of the radome under the ozone environment, thirdly, built an accelerated degradation model based on chemical kinetics, at the same time use the data to calculate the parameters, and verify the validity of the model. finally, give a material life assessment method in ozone environment.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent control of thin-walled plastic parts forming quality based on CAE and DOE technology
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In the injection molding process of thin-walled plastic parts, many process parameters have great influence on warpage. It has become an important means to control and optimize the injection molding process parameters and improve the molding quality by means of computer-aided technology and orthogonal test. In this paper, the upper cover part of a certain type of display instrument is studied. SolidWorks 2012 software is used to model it, and moldflow 2012 software is used to create pouring system and cooling system. The orthogonal experiment is designed by combining CAE and DOE technology. The appropriate orthogonal experiment table is selected. The mold temperature, melt temperature, packing time and packing pressure are taken as experimental factors. Through the simulation experiment, the conclusion of influencing factors is obtained, that is, packing time > mold temperature > melt temperature > packing pressure. At the same time, the optimal combination of process parameters was determined, that is, the melt temperature is 250°C, the mold temperature is 30°C, the packing pressure is 90 MPa, and the packing time is 8s. The optimal process combination simulation experiment results show that the warpage deformation is 0.2960mm, which is 25.29% lower than the previous minimum deformation, which effectively reduces the warpage deformation of thin-walled plastic parts and improves the forming quality of the upper cover of the display instrument.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Prediction Method of Aircraft External Stores Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for predicting the vibration environment of aircraft external stores based on deep belief network, which based on the relationship between the vibration environment, pressure altitude and Mach number of the aircraft external stores in flight. Firstly, GJB 150.16A empirical formulas were analyzed and then generating simulation data, which a total of 7470 sets. Secondly, linear regression and deep belief network models were set up respectively, and deep belief network number of hidden layer node was optimized, then the expected errors of two methods were compared and analyzed, including root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE) and mean relative error (MRE). Finally, DBN method was applied to a case for prediction the vibration of a certain aircraft store, intending to verify the feasibility and accuracy of DBN method. The results show that the DBN model can fully characterize the non-linear relationship between the pressure altitude, Mach number and RMS value of the aircraft external stores in the flight environment, and the overall expected effect is better than linear regression. The expected mean relative error is less than ± 3 dB. This method has provided a new way to predict the vibration environment of aircraft external stores, and is of great significance for PHM in the whole life of aviation weapon equipment.

articleTitle: An Improved Autogram and its Application in Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Envelope analysis is one of the most advantageous methods in rolling element bearing (REB) diagnosis, but the determination of the informative frequency band (IFB) is always a huge challenge. In order to reduce the influence of discrete frequency components and strong background noise to choose IFB, a new improved Autogram is provided. Firstly, the Cepstrum pre-whitening (CPW) is taken as a preprocessing method to reduce the interference from discrete frequency components in the signal. Then, the Autogram is used to decompose the pre-whitening signal and the optimal IFB is selected for a further demodulation. The simulated signals and a set of experiment signals are taken to verify its validity. The results indicates that this method can successfully address the interference generated by discrete frequency and strong background noise, and effectively extract the weak fault features of bearing.

articleTitle: On Improving the Monotonicity-Based Evaluation Method For Selecting Features/Health Indicators for Prognostics
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Degradation is, in general, an irreversible process where the state of a system changes from a healthy to an unhealthy state and eventually to a failure state. In the context of the Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) of industrial assets, it is of paramount importance to accurately and reliably estimate the remaining useful life (RUL) of an asset to better plan a maintenance action such that a near-zero downtime can be achieved. The performance of a prognostic algorithm depends highly on the input data, namely prognostic features or health indicators. One of the important attributes of being a good feature for prognostics is monotonicity behaviour. Several methods, based on the monotonicity criterion, for example by computing the so-called separability index, to evaluate the quality of features/health indicators for prognostics have been proposed in the literature, see [1]-[3]. In this paper, we carefully examined these existing methods on various time-series features that are numerically simulated. It appears in some cases that the methods reported in the literature might lead to counterintuitive results. Notably, when feature trends are noisy, the existing methods might even lead to misleading assessment. To remedy this, we improved the method by replacing the separability index with the Euclidean distance and replacing the mutual information ranking with Pearson's correlation ranking. The experimental results show that the improved method is robust against noise and outperforms the existing methods.

articleTitle: Design of Lithium-ion Battery Monitoring System with Diagnostic Interface
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: This paper proposes a lithium-ion battery monitoring system with diagnostic interface for marine equipment. In this system, Arduino Nano is used as its main control chip; LTC6811 and AD8210 are used for voltage and current monitoring of lithium-ion batteries; the internal state of battery pack is monitored through the temperature, humidity, water leakage and fire sensors; the protection circuits and battery pack on-line / off-line test control circuits are designed. Moreover, the embedded program and communication protocol are constructed on the basis of hardware. Finally, the experimental results show that the system can accurately obtain the status information of the lithium-ion battery pack in real time.

articleTitle: Hopf bifurcation analysis for a generalized Lorenz system with single delay
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In this paper, we present a single time-delay system based on a new generalized Lorenz system. We found that the new system belongs to the generalized Lorenz system family by analyzing its linear term. We obtained the Hopf bifurcation condition and the time-delay parameters through the method of calculating the equilibrium point and analyzing equilibrium stability and Hopf bifurcation. The simulation images of the system under different time-delay parameters were drawn. We concluded that the introduction of time-delay in the generalized Lorenz system improved overall stability. At the time-delay parameter $\tau$=1. 5708, the system appeared relatively stable limit cycle and occurred supercritical Hopf bifurcation. Changing the delay parameters near the delay bifurcation point would affect the stability of the system.

articleTitle: A Tor Anonymity Attack Experiment Platform Driven by Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Private Tor network is essential for analyzing security issues both for Tor project as well as for numerous researchers. However, current research work mainly focus on improving scalability and efficiency by simulating traffic discretely with single node and restoration level by deploying a complete private network with high cost. In this paper, we propose a novel methodology constructing real private tor network by editing and controlling Raspberry Pis, called Tor anonymity attack experiment platform. Compared with other platforms of the same type, the platform has the advantages of low cost, easy to scale, high quality of real-time data transmission, high degree of network protocol restoration as well as convenient configuration. In order to demonstrate the platform can be used as a private and complete Tor anonymous network experiment environment, we conduct a source tracing attack as a study case. Experimental results and theoretical analysis both show that the platform can support researchers to carry out numerous Tor network security research with high degree of restoration efficiently and cheaply.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation on the Hot Switching Capability and Associated Failure Mechanism of Electrical Connectors
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The hot switching ability of connectors is urgently required for electrical engineering applications. In this paper, a novel test rig for simulation of mechanical insertion and withdrawal operation with electric duty is designed. The waveforms of tangential force, contact current, contact voltage and switching power of typical blade and turning-fork contact pairs during the hot switching process are measured simultaneously. In the electrical endurance experiments, the variations in arc energy and tangential force of blade and receptacle pairs as a function of operation cycles are presented and interpreted explicitly. Finally, the roles of sliding wear and arcing erosion in the degradation process of electrical connector are discussed.

articleTitle: Foreign Object Impact Detection and Identification Test of Fan Blade
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In order to master the detection and identification technology of foreign object impact on fan blade on noninterference blade tip vibration measurement, fan blade test platform for detection and identification of foreign object impact was designed and built. Lots of experiments were carried out under different working conditions such as projectile mass, launching speed and fan speed. The criterion of foreign object impact identification was preliminarily given before the identification results were verified through high speed camera. The difference of the recognition accuracy under different projectile mass and rotating speed conditions, and qualitative rule between impact factors and blade tip vibration was analyzed. It is concluded that the detection and identification system could accurately determine the impact event with the number of impact blade. The identification accuracy of the system reaches 100% under the conditions of fan speed in the range of $ 1800\sim 4000r/min$ and the mass of the projectile greater than 2.9 g. The conclusions provide important test data and basis for establishing intelligent detection and identification methods for foreign object impact.

articleTitle: Life Prediction Method of Nonlinear Degradation Equipment Based on Adaptive Unscented Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: To solve the problem that degradation process is changeable, a life prediction method based on adaptive unscented particle filter (AUPF) is proposed. Firstly, the nonlinear stochastic degradation process based on the state space model is established. According to the concept of first arrival time and the fault probability density function (PDF), the approximate life distribution is given. Then, a real-time degradation state and noise estimation algorithm based on unscented particle filter (UPF) and Sage-Husa filter is proposed to update the life distribution online. Finally, the validity of the prediction method is verified by simulation experiments and life prediction of motorized spindle.

articleTitle: Error Analysis on Parameters Measurement Model of Wheel-Mounted Four-Wheel Alignment
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that measurement models on different parameters would produce different theoretical errors, this paper proposes an error analysis method on parameters measurement model of wheel-mounted four-wheel alignment. Through the analysis of theoretical errors on different measurement models, we select the one with less error to improve measurement accuracy. The experiment results indicate that under experimental conditions, measurement model II on wheel camber angle, model I on kingpin inclination angle and model II on kingpin caster angle generate the less error respectively. This error analysis method can help select the optimal four-wheel alignment parameters measurement model and the experimental results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Health Assessment Method of Avionics Processing System Based on Mahalanobis Distance
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In this paper, we study the health management of general processing system in avionics system. Based on our health assessment laboratory prototype platform, the degradation state and fault of the system are simulated by fault injection. We collected the sensitive state parameters of the system, and carried out health assessment of avionics processing system based on distance measurement. In the fault injection experiment, we simulate three typical progressive faults and verify the predictive fidelity of health assessment results based on distance measurement. The research results of this paper have certain engineering application value for avionics system condition based health management and maintenance support ability improvement.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling of Mutually DCFP System Considering Degradation Causes the Shock Threshold Descent
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Many systems experience dependent competing failure processes (DCFP) resulting due to degradation processes and random shocks. In some complex systems, the threshold of random shocks will descend because of the degradation processes. According to previous researches, two cases of shock threshold descent will be considered. The first case is the hard failure threshold decent to a lower value when derogation exceeds the critical degradation value. The second case is the hard failure threshold decent continuously with the increasing degradation. In mutually DCFP system, the two cases of hard failure threshold decent will exist simultaneously, so they compete with each other. In this paper, a case of laser lithography machine will be introduced to verify the theory derivation. The Monte Carlo sampling method will be used to sample and simulate the case data to obtain the reliability of the system. The result showed that when shock threshold descent, the reliability of the system drops significantly.

articleTitle: Failure Impact Analyzing of a Chemical Plant based on its DCS Data Set
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The core monitor system in process industry is called Distributed Control System (DCS), which has numerous sensors whose types are various. It is a challenge to calculate the fault score of the overall operating status of the equipment corresponding to each sensor in the DCS data set. This paper presented a method to calculate the impact of abnormal elements to the system operation status. First, form a classifier matrix based on the baseline of the characteristics of the system. Second, obtain fault contribution of each element by calculating classifier matrix. Hence, fault tracing of the system could be realized by sequencing fault score. Conventional simulation named Tennessee Eastman process is introduced to verify the method.

articleTitle: Degradation Reliability Evaluation of Mechanical Product Considering Individual Differences
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In the process of evaluating the overall reliability of products, ignoring the impact of individual differences will lead to inaccurate reliability evaluation results. Based on the reliability modeling in Gamma process, the author introduced individual difference as a random factor into the overall reliability evaluation process of the product, and studied the realtime reliability evaluation of the individual product, and finally verified it with gear degradation data. It is concluded that, firstly, when evaluating the overall reliability, the reliability model considering individual differences is more accurate; Secondly. when evaluating the individual reliability, the overall prior information can accurately improve the accuracy of the individual reliability assessment; Thirdly, the longer the monitoring time of degradation data, the more accurate the reliability assessment results will be. It effectively improves the accuracy of overall and individual reliability assessment of mechanical products and provides guidance for monitoring degradation data.
