articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Infusion and Data-Physics Model Based Remaining Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The electromechanical system has high-dimensional sensor information, which often suffers multiple working conditions. Therefore, it is necessary and challenging to study multi-sensor fusion technology under variable loads. In this paper, we proposed a method for predicting remaining useful life under time-varying working load based on multi-sensor fusion and data-physical models. First of all, we established the main sensor selection model through principal component analysis. Then, the multi-sensor information fusion model under variable load was obtained by combining with the constructed load, sensor data and the location scale model of the failure time. Finally, the C-MAPSS dataset was used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Damage Physical Features Extraction Algorithms Based on Denoising FBG Signal in Aluminum Alloy Structures
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Fiber Bragg gratings (FBG) sensor has attracted considerable attention for structural health monitoring (SHM) in aerospace aluminum alloy structures in recent years. The experimental FBG signals used to detect flaws contains noise. Therefore, in this paper, an algorithm that combines variational mode decomposition (VMD) with discrete wavelet transform (DWT) was proposed to deal with the signal denoising problem. Then, it is a challenge problem for structural damage detection to extract the features that sensitive to damage and robust to noise from the FBG signal response. This paper presents several damage features extraction algorithms, such as the multi-peaks central wavelength algorithm, full width at half Maximum (FWHM) algorithm, the spectral difference algorithm and the spectral area algorithm. Then, the denoised structure signal can be used to test the damage features extraction algorithm effectiveness and for future damage detection.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Blade-casing Rubbing Considering Thermal Effect
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Thermal effect is one of the most significant phenomena of rubbing fault, and seriously affects the dynamic characteristics of the rotor system. In this paper, the blade-casing rubbing experimental device with multi-position temperature measurement was built to analyze the rotor dynamics considering the thermal effect. First, the static heating experiment was carried out to simulate the influence of the frictional thermal effect on the blade during the rubbing process. The relationship between the blade temperature and the heating time was obtained, and the temperature field of the blade during the rubbing process can be obtained approximately. Then the dynamic rubbing experiment was carried out. Multiple PTIOO thermistor sensors were fixed on the blade, and the temperature signals were transmitted to the acquisition through a collector ring. The vibration of the shaft was obtained by the eddy-current sensors. The experimental results show that the temperature change has a threshold effect, and the magnitude of the temperature change is positively correlated with the intrusion of the blade to the casing, which can provide a theoretical basis and experimental support for the numerical simulation of the thermal effect of the actual blade-casing rubbing.

articleTitle: Investigate Axial Dynamization Movement by Using Genetic Algorithm Method Based on a Unilateral External Fixator
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Unilateral external fixators are commonly used to stabilize the fractured tibia bone. Compared with static fixation, axial dynamic motion can be used for promoting callus formation, improving bone healing at fracture sites. Moreover, non-axial motions are not conductive to promoting bone healing and remodeling. However, a fixator-bone system with 7(DOFs) can not achieve both fracture correction and axial dynamic motion. Maybe it is easy to think that this problem could be solved by adding one DOF for fixator structure. However the increased structural flexibility could not be able to meet the demands of lower cost and size, and higher stiffness. Thus, how a fixator-bone system with 7 DOFs not only can realize fracture correction, but also complete axial dynamic motion as far as possible. So far, researchers have never solved this problem. Therefore, we establish a mathematical model based on the 7 DOFs Orthofix fixators, and try to use the genetic algorithm method to reduce the tangential displacements in the process of axial dynamization after fracture correction. The results suggest that the use of genetic optimization algorithm can effectively reduce tangential displacement. This study helps facilitate appropriate and flexibility application of fixators to better control axial dynamic motion and decrease tangential displacements.

articleTitle: Fault Trending of an Automatic Double Threaded Trampoline Webbing Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: This paper applies signal processing methodology on a specially designed webbing machine to evaluate and improve the trampoline manufacturing process. Digital Signal Processing (DSP) methods such as Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), and Statistical Process Control (SPC) have been applied to find singular frequencies, but the results are not satisfactory. Instead, a Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT) based methodology is used to predict the fault before it occurred. Unlike the traditional wavelet scalogram method, the collected data in the research is separated into small segments, and the divided segments are used to generate scalograms. By observing and counting the pulses in different frequency ranges in scalograms, the singular frequency ranges can highlight the trending to fault occurrence. Additionally, a timer is used in the experiment to record the time when the fault occurred. This information validates accuracy of the method and demonstrates that this novel fault trending detection method has a promising usage in recognizing the trending of faults.

articleTitle: Maintenance Strategy for Multi-Component Systems Based on Structure and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Maintenance strategy becomes more complicated as system becoming more complex while higher availability and economic requirements are required. A maintenance strategy with combining corrective maintenance and preventive maintenance is proposed. An adaptive opportunistic maintenance decision rule considering both the criticality level of components and their deterioration threshold is introduced. A preventive decision rule based on both structural importance of components and their predictive reliability is presented. Both economic and structure dependencies between components are studied in the model. Moreover, a mean system maintenance cost model is introduced to Figure out the optimal decision parameters. Monte Carlo simulation is used for algorithm calculation. The numerical results show that the proposed strategy provides more advantages in maintenance decision-making, while reducing maintenance cost and system shut-down time, hence can raise system availability.

articleTitle: Power and Resource Allocation in Sensor Network Using Harmony Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: For the communication of information over sensor networks, power consumption, and spectrum usage play a significant role. As the number of sensors increases tremendously, it’s vital to optimize power and spectrum usage. The HSA has already been implemented for repetitive subcarrier and power allocation in smart downlink multicarrier systems to accurately implement power and subcarrier allocation. This work maximizes energy efficiency through routing optimization in a senor communication network using a harmony search algorithm. Simulation results describe the significant improvement in a network life time and residual energy of nodes.

articleTitle: Distributed Fault Diagnosis for Electro-hydraulic Suspension by Model Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: This paper presents a distributed fault diagnosis approach for electro-hydraulic suspension system based on model decomposition technique. As a complex nonlinear system, the electro-hydraulic suspension involves various components and traditionally centralized diagnosis method will suffer from some problems such as poor scalability, high computation cost and so on. To solve above problems, the distributed diagnosis approach is adopted in this paper. Firstly, the diagnostic hybrid bond graph model of electro-hydraulic suspension system is decomposed into several submodels by model decomposition technique. Then, the distributed analytical redundancy relations are derived from each submodel for fault detection, and the fault signature matrix is constructed to isolate possible faults set (PFS). After that, a Cuckoo Search algorithm cooperated with differential evolution is proposed to determine the true faults from the PFS. Finally, simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed distributed method.

articleTitle: A Case Study on the Impact of Working Conditions for Machinery Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Variation in working conditions imposes great challenges for machinery fault diagnosis, especially for data-driven fault diagnosis and prognosis. This paper presents an experiment which employs a rotary torsional fatigue test bench to study the impact of working conditions on the dynamic behavior of a mechanical system. Vibration signals were acquired under a normal condition and a compound bearing fault condition with a working-condition matrix composed of 6 working loads and 5 rotating speeds. The impact of working load and rotating speed is qualitatively revealed by the frequency spectrum and time-domain features of the acquired vibration signals.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Electrostatic OLS and WSS
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Electrostatic monitoring technology is a new state monitoring method used in the Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) of mechanical system. This technology can be used to monitor the tribo-contacts and wear of mechanical equipment by using two kinds of electrostatic sensors with different shapes and structures, i.e. oil-line sensor (OLS) and wear-site sensor (WSS). Due to the different induced charges generated in Electrostatic Sensors, in order to express the spatial distribution of induction region of electrostatic sensors more clearly, it is necessary to research and analysis the spatial sensitivity of the two kinds of electrostatic sensors. This paper first introduced their mathematical models and parameters, then conduct a comparative analysis with their characteristics of spatial sensitivity.

articleTitle: Trial Risk Assessment Based on Total Utility of Generalized Fuzzy Numbers
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a risk assessment method based on total utility of generalized fuzzy numbers (GFNs) towards trial process management. Firstly, the possible risk events in trial business process are sorted out according to trial experience and expertise of law experts. Then the occurrence probability, impact degree and repairability are used as evaluation factors and we transform corresponding evaluation descriptions into form of GFNs. Then multiple experts’ evaluations will be aggregated to get fuzzy risk value. Finally, we de-fuzzy the fuzzy risk value by calculating total utility of GFNs, achieving the purpose of risk assessment. Proposed method mainly solves two core problems. The first is that we use GFNs to express and calculate fuzzy risks after analyzing risk events, avoiding subjectivity and uncertainty in traditional risk assessment methods. The second is that we de-fuzzy the fuzzy risk value by calculating total utility of GFNs based on Maximum and Minimum Set, obtaining exact risk value as the ranking basis for accurate risk assessment. We have applied proposed method into real trial cases to realize the evaluation of trial risks for judicial business, and the results demonstrate accuracy, effectiveness and applicability of proposed method in trial scenes.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Method for Reliability Prediction of Pyrotechnical System
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of errors in the reliability prediction calculation of pyrotechnical systems based on the Monte Carlo simulation method, this paper studies the three aspects of series and parallel systems, the number of components, and the parameters of the Monte Carlo simulation method to improve the accuracy of the reliability prediction simulation calculation method. The results show that the order of the reliability calculation errors from small to large is parallel system <; hybrid system <; series system, the reliability calculation error can be evaluated by the series system, and the calculation error obtained is the maximum error of the system. When calculating the reliability by Monte Carlo simulation method, the system needs to be simplified in series and parallel, and the number of random sampling elements in the system should be minimized to reduce the calculation error of the Monte Carlo simulation method. The number of samples has a significant impact on the Monte Carlo simulation method. To improve the calculation accuracy of reliability, but due to the limitation of computer memory and calculation time, it is recommended to take a sample size of n = 10000000, the repeated calculation times of the Monte Carlo simulation method can stabilize the calculation results, and it is recommended to choose the number N = 1000. The control of the statistical value of the sampling individual components has a significant effect on reducing the calculation error of the Monte Carlo simulation method. It is recommended that the absolute error of random number sampling be limited to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Fault Diagnosis and Health Management System of Special Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In order to improve the informatization, intelligence and actual combat capacity of the equipment, the fault diagnosis and health management system of special vehicles are constructed based on the integration of advance technologies such as physics of failure of the vehicle system, artificial intelligence technology, advanced sensor networks, ad hoc network communication, etc. We firstly propose the function and performance demands of the fault diagnosis and health management system. Secondly, the composition and framework of this system are put forward to describe its subsystem and their relationship. Thirdly, the detailed design for hardware and software is implemented to realize various system functions. Finally, we present an operating mode and a typical deployment scheme of the system. By designing the system, the upgrade of the actual combat capacity and intelligence level of special vehicles can be achieved.

articleTitle: The Study of Relationship Between Crack Direction and Self-transmitting Magnetic Signal Under Axial Load
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The crack direction is one of the key factors affecting the crack growth rate, and then determines the crack growth life of the structure. Therefore, it is very important to determine the crack direction when evaluating the structure safety. Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to determine the crack direction accurately by Magnetic Nondestructive Testing Technology, this paper first analyzes the basic law between the crack direction and the magnetization direction based on the crack magnetic charge model. On this basis, the specimens with four groups of cracks of different directions were designed, and four levels of axial tensile load were applied to the specimens for test verification. During the test, the self-emission magnetic signals of cracks were collected and the signal characteristics were analyzed. The theoretical and experimental results show that the vertical component of the self-emission magnetic signal corresponding to the cracks in different directions has typical characteristics of positive and negative peaks. The gradient of positive and negative peaks changed greatly. The axial tensile load can enhance the magnetic field. The peak-to-peak value of each crack increases with the increase of axial tensile load. When the crack direction is perpendicular to the axis of tensile load, the peak-to-peak value is the largest and the speed of peak-to-peak is the fastest. There is a strong correlation between the crack angle and the gradient of the distorted magnetic field signal.

articleTitle: Acceleration Life Test Design Method of Electronic Module Under Multiple Coupling Stress Condition
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Under complex working conditions, solder joints are often subjected to the combined effects of temperature, vibration, humidity, and electrical stress. Under the coupling of multiple stresses, its life is significantly shorter than that of a single stress. Therefore, studying the failure mechanism and acceleration factor calculation method of solder joints under the coupling of multiple stresses is very important to accurately evaluate or predict the life of electronic products in engineering. In order to more accurately predict the product life under the action of multiple stresses, a new method for calculating the acceleration factor of solder joints under the coupling of multiple stresses is proposed in this paper. By studying the failure mechanism of the solder joints of electronic products under a single stress and the interaction of the failure mechanisms under the coupling of two or more stresses, the calculation methods of the solder joint life and acceleration factors under two or more stress couplings are obtained. Taking a circuit board as an example, the acceleration factor of the accelerated test of the interconnection solder joint under the coupling of temperature, humidity, vibration and electrical stress is calculated.

articleTitle: A Method of Identifying Pitot Tube Cover Based on Color Histogram Features and SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The pitot tube cover is a ground protection device used to avoid the error of airspeed indication caused by foreign objects entering the pitot tube during the parking period and thus threatening the aviation safety. At the same time, the aircraft taking off without taking off the pitot tube cover is also a serious threat to aviation safety, so a method for identifying this kind of production defects is proposed. The existing 36 pitot tube on-site images (with and without covers) were preprocessed using the improved sliding window object detection algorithm and the image enhancement method based on the grayscale transformation. The color histogram features of the processed images was extracted. Using SVM for fault recognition, and the parameters of SVM are optimized by K-CV method. After optimization, the cross validated identification rate can up to 96%. The proposed method can be applied to the inspection of UAV around the aircraft, which is conducive to improving the PHM capability of civil aircraft pitot-static pressure system.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Selecting Underlying Variables of a Stochastic Degradation Process
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: A unit degrades with time and usage. The degradation can be represented by a stochastic process model, which can be used to predict the unit's residual life distribution so as to make condition-based operation and maintenance decisions. Stochastic degradation models can be age-, state and age-state-dependent. A challenging issue is how to select a realistic degradation model with appropriate variables. This paper presents a robust approach to address this issue. The proposed approach first transforms the degradation amount data into the degradation rate data. The transformed data then are displayed in four different coordinate systems (degradation rate and its reciprocal vs. age and state, respectively) and the statistical characteristics (e.g., linear correlation and variability) of the data in these coordinate systems are examined. The best coordinate system is chosen based on these characteristics and relevant rules. Once the optimal coordinate system is determined, the degradation rate or its reciprocal is represented by a linear or sectional linear function of age or state. The degradation model built in such a way has small nonlinearity and variability. This can lead to a simple degradation model and robust residual life prediction. The advantages of the model and its applications are illustrated by a real-world example.

articleTitle: Reliably Evaluation Method Considering FM Dependency via Uncertainty Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The dependence of failure mechanisms indicates that system failure initiates from dependent failure mechanisms. One failure mechanism developing to a certain degree will trigger, accelerate or inhibit another or many other failure mechanisms and some kind of failure mechanisms may have the same effect on the failure site, component or system. Because of the uncertainty of these correlations of failure mechanisms, it is difficult to predict the degradation process of system and evaluate the reliability of complex system with correlations of failure mechanisms. This paper introduces the uncertainty theory to model the degradation process of failure for the epistemic uncertainty. The geometric Liu process is used to describe the degradation process. Different failure time models are built for different correlations of failure mechanisms and corresponding belief reliability distributions are derived. Some numerical cases are designed to verify these models.

articleTitle: A Method of Reliability Allocation optimization Based on Lifecycle Cost Constraint
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: According to the characteristics of aerospace equipment engineering development and the practical needs of low-cost design, a method of reliability allocation optimization considering multi-parameter exponential distribution based on cost constraint, is proposed, and according to the composition and proportion of the lifecycle cost of aerospace equipment, the relationship between the development cost, operation and support cost and reliability is studied, and further research is given to the optimization method of reliability allocation considering lifecycle cost constraint. Finally, the genetic algorithm is used to solve the nonlinear optimization model. This paper solves the problem of cost constraints and closed-loop control of aerospace equipment reliability indicators.

articleTitle: LSSVM prediction model based on improved kernel parameter selection method
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern science and technology, especially electronic information technology, the application of electronic information technology in communication, aerospace and industrial systems is becoming more and more complex. The intelligence and complexity of the system are constantly improving, and the structure of devices and equipment is becoming more and more complex, and the degree of automation is high. Fault prediction studies the future of equipment, one is to understand the future development trend of equipment health status, prepare for a rainy day in advance. Second, it can make more scientific decisions on equipment management and application through prediction. There are two aspects in the application of fault prediction: one is to predict the unknown data according to the current monitoring data, and infer whether the current equipment or equipment status is normal according to the standard of the unknown data; the other is to estimate the remaining life before the failure may occur in the future according to the previous data experience. For the shortage of electronic circuit fault prediction technology, this paper describes a variety of fault prediction methods (fault prediction based on grey system, fault prediction based on particle filter, fault prediction technology based on support vector machine), and briefly describes their advantages and disadvantages, introduces SVM, nonlinear SVM prediction method and nonlinear LSSVM prediction method in detail. With the further research of LSSVM model, the kernel parameter selection of nonlinear prediction model has gradually become the focus of SVM model application. Based on the existing LSSVM model, this paper proposes a new kernel parameter selection method, which enhances the application ability of LSSVM model. By comparing with the traditional LSSVM model, the effectiveness of the proposed method is proved.

articleTitle: Division of Rolling Bearing Health Stage Based on Multi-Domain Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The division of rolling bearing failure stages is essential in the maintenance of rotating machinery. In order to classify the bearing failure stage more accurately in different situations, a rolling bearing health stage division method based on multi-domain features is proposed. The clustering algorithm is used to extract the sensitive features of rolling bearing health at each stage, and multiple Features merge into a degenerate curve. The index adaptively divides the entire life of the bearing into multiple health states and is verified by the frequency domain components of each stage. The results show that the method proposed can validly classify the health status of bearings.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Maintenance Strategy of Complex Equipment System
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In recent years, the complex equipment system presents the rapid development of integration and intelligence, and it is easy to break down when it works in bad environment for a long time. The maintenance support ability and comprehensive maintenance economic benefit of the complex equipment system play an important role in the defense ability. Therefore, in order to improve the combat readiness of equipment, solve the current situation of economic loss and low operation ability caused by insufficient or excessive maintenance. In this paper, a dynamic maintenance strategy for complex equipment system is proposed. The goal of this maintenance strategy is to minimize the average cost in a short period of time,to update the running state of the system and the execution time of fault maintenance in real time. Finally, the effectiveness of the dynamic maintenance strategy proposed in this paper is verified by the analysis of maintenance model parameters. The dynamic maintenance strategy proposed in this paper considers the operation state and economic cost of complex equipment system, which is more applicable to practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Research on Detecting Algorithm for Data Inconsistency in Remote Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Combining the characteristics of the networked network test system and the strong database distribution, the problems caused by data redundancy and physical distribution in the database-the inconsistency of the data in the database are proposed [1]. The data inconsistency detection algorithm is studied, the commonly used checkpoint algorithm is analyzed, and the checkpoint algorithm is improved. The test site actively sends test information to reduce the system communication overhead, and implemented in the remote test database system. Finally, this improved algorithm is summarized.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis for Commercial SiC MOSFETs in Single Pulse and Repetitive Surge Current Test
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: SiC MOSFET Body diodes are expected to compete against SiC schottky barrier diodes (SBD) in high power applications. To investigate the surge capability of the body diodes in commercial SiC MOSFETs, single pulse and repetitive surge current tests are processed on the DUTs. In single pulse surge current test, the DUTs are stressed to failure. Compared with the body diodes in SiC trench-gate MOSFETs, the body diodes in SiC planar-gate MOSFETs tend to show better surge capability at all rated current levels. On the other hand, in repetitive surge current test, the degradation of electrical parameters is observed after hundreds of pulse cycles. The degradation mechanism of bipolar degradation and oxide layer degradation has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement of Chromium Plating Corrosion for Piston Rod in Marine Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: In order to solve the corrosion issue of the piston rod coating of the anti-aircraft tank outrigger in the marine environment, the corrosion mechanism of the chrome plating substrate is analyzed based on a case of fault. The results can provide a theoretical basis and direction for the diagnosis and improvement of the corrosion problem of the outrigger piston rod. The characteristics of the inherent cracks in the chromium layer are analyzed. Then, the improved methods using Ep.Cr30oCr70hd and sealant treatment on the coating surface is proposed. The salt spray tests and practical applications show that the surface treatment of piston rods with double-layer chromium and sealant has a good anti-corrosion effect.

articleTitle: Civil Aircraft LORA and Maintenance Resource Integrated Optimation
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: This paper mainly considers the situation of joint planning of repair levels and maintenance resources, and studies the planning and configuration of civil aircraft maintenance resources under different repair modes. The research on the joint planning technology of civil aircraft repair level and maintenance resources under the multi-level repair mode was carried out.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Inherent Characteristics of the Power Transmission System of the Shearer’s Rocker Arm
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Taking the typical rocker arm drive system of shearer as the research object, considering the influence of shaft section, bearing, gear (including planetary gear system) and concentrated mass, the finite element model of bending torsion coupling of the whole rocker arm drive system is established, its inherent characteristics are solved, and the main failure parts and failure forms of the system are predicted. The conclusion is that the system shows strong coupling vibration. When the system rotates at low frequency, the main vibration is on the planetary gear subsystem.

articleTitle: Health State Evaluation for Production Systems by Aggregating Multi-source Data based Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Modern production systems are the carriers that advanced manufacturing technologies can be realized. Accurate health state evaluation is the basis for ensuring stable operation of the production system and developing a maintenance strategy However, the most existing health evaluation techniques of production systems are based on the single source data. The multi-source data based hidden Markov model is proposed to evaluate health state (including machine performance data, process quality data, etc.). The operational features-based health definition of the production system of production systems is proposed. The modeling process of hidden Markov model based on multi-source data is given, and the multi-performance degradation law of production system is revealed. And taking the pre-grinding gear hob production system as an example, the accuracy and superiority of this proposed approach are verified.

articleTitle: Comparison of Single and Multiple Threshold Used in Detecting Errors of Distribution Transformer Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Distribution transformer connectivity (DTC) is an important basic data. The correctness of DTC will significantly affect the management of distribution network losses and maintenance of distribution networks. In order to verify DTC, a data-driven method has been proposed. The basis of the method is to calculate the similarity of the secondary side voltage of the distribution transformer. The similarity threshold will be used to determine whether the DTC of a feeder is correct. In this paper, in order to compare the performance of the single and multiple thresholds, a dataset which includes 182 10kV feeders and 4142 distribution transformers have been collected. Among the 182 feeders, there are 172 feeders whose DTC are correct. The rest of the 10 feeders whose DTC are incorrect. The receiver operating characteristic (ROC) graphs of the two types of thresholds has been drawn. The area under curve (AUC) of single-threshold is 0.886, while the AUC of multiple-threshold is 0.986. Results show the performance of multiple-threshold is better compared with single-threshold.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Diagnosis Method of Bearing Fault Based on Acoustic Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Acoustic signals are widespread applied in fault diagnosis. However, it is still a difficult problem to extract feature of acoustic signals under large rotation speed fluctuation. Sparse filtering (SF) as an effective unsupervised algorithm, has been skillfully applied in many fields. However, the effect of SF on acoustic signal processing under large rotation speed fluctuation is not ideal. Hence, we proposed an effective feature learning algorithm called deep sparse filtering (DSF) to overcome this teaser. Firstly, frequency domain signals are used as the basis of DSF for feature leaning, then weight adjustment is performed by back propagation (BP). The efficiency of the DSF model is verified by the collected bearing data set.

articleTitle: Analysis of the detection technology of the strength and deformation of the elevator landing door
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The deformation strength of elevator landing doors is an important factor that directly affects the safety of elevators. Insufficient door strength can easily cause elevators to fall off, resulting in serious accidents such as people injury. This paper analyzes the inspection requirements, inspection devices, and inspection techniques of the strength of the elevator landing doors, combined with the author's inspection experience, expounds common inspection risks, and proposes targeted solutions.

articleTitle: Fuel Systems Structure Reliability Design and Analysis of Supersonic Business-Jet Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: The development of the civil aviation has some directions. One of them relates with creating new ideas about civil supersonic flight. Some time ago, there were two successful civil supersonic airplanes projects. In modern time, in different countries some companies try to develop new projects about supersonic business-jet airplanes. Other research direction in civil aviation is structural and system reliability improvement. The supersonic flight requires higher reliability than usually subsonic flight. One of the important system of the any aircraft is its fuel system that provides continuous engine operations and structural reliability directly influencing to the full airplanes' reliability. Flight safety depends on its normal operation. Therefore, the task of the fuel system reliability is actual especially for the supersonic flight. Analysis of the supersonic flight specifics for the civil purpose were done. The general structure and system arrangement for the supersonic business-jet were proposed. Feeding fuel system layout and its reliability research was done. Real structural reliability was compared with analytical calculation and rational structural solutions for the reliability adjustment were proposed.

articleTitle: A Novel Two-stage Feature Extraction Based on Multi-fractal Spectrum with CI-VMD for Early Fault Diagnosis of Bearing
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Rolling bearing failure represents the most universal fault in the rotating machine, consequently, early fault detection for rolling bearing could be regarded as an effective scheme to perform maintenance decision-making. However, it is difficult to extract the characteristics sensitive to the early fault of rolling bearings under complex operating conditions, as the weak incipient fault signals are always easily drown in the strong background noise. To overcome the problem, this paper proposed a two-stage strategy that in the context of the denoising process to construct fault signatures, which are employed for early bearing fault diagnosis. First, the Comprehensive Indicator and Variational Mode Decomposition (CI-VMD) method is performed to determine the optimal decomposition level K of VMD. And then, to reconstruct the noise reduction signal, a criterion based on the correlation is employed to select the optimal intrinsic mode functions (OIMF). Afterwards, the optimum multi-fractal features could be extracted in multifractal spectra calculated by Multi-fractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MF-DFA). An experimental case is implemented to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed approach. These results demonstrate the capability of the method in identifying the initial fault occurring time of rolling element bearings.

articleTitle: Holistic Comparison of Different Kernel Functions for Support Vector Regression Based on State-of-health Prediction of Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Battery health prediction is an important part of prognostic and health management. It is particularly important to accurately predict the state of health (SOH) in the management of lithium-ion batteries. Owing to its excellent regression ability, support vector regression (SVR) is the preferred data-driven method used to predict the remaining useful life (RUL) of batteries. Kernel functions, such as linear, polynomial, gaussian, and sigmoid kernels are commonly used to map samples from a lower to a higher dimensional space for accurate classification. Parameter estimation considerably affects the mapping ability of kernel functions. The size and distribution of the training set also affect the regression ability of SVR. In this study, lithium-ion battery data are divided into prophase, metaphase, and anaphase training data. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) and a genetic algorithm (GA) are applied to optimize the parameters of the four kernel functions. A comparison of the experimental results showed that GA-SVR with a radial basis function (RBF) and PSO-SVR with an RBF in the anaphase can accurately predict the RUL of lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Review of Artificial Intelligence-based Bearing Vibration Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Bearing is one of the most commonly used components in rotating machinery. Effective bearing health monitoring is very important for safe operation of mechanical equipment, which has been a difficult task due to complex operation conditions and different uncertainties. In recent years, the development of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies has provided new opportunities for bearing health monitoring. AI-based vibration monitoring makes it easier to identify the health status of one bearing than traditional methods, which has become a research hot-spot. Many studies have been done to detect and predict the condition of a bearing by using advanced AI algorithms. The aim of this paper is to review the development of machine learning and deep learning methods for bearing vibration monitoring. In particular, several issues of current studies are addressed and future development trends are discussed.

articleTitle: Fault Feature Extraction of Rolling Bearing Based on Improved VMD-SVD Joint Denoising and Synchrosqueezing Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Bearing faults are the main contributors to the failure of motors. To solve the problem of extracting fault features from bearing signals with low signal-to-noise ratio, a method combining improved Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD) -Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) joint denoising with synchrosqueezing wavelet transform is proposed. The proposed method is based on the analysis of VMD-SVD theory. In view of the existing problems of VMD-SVD, the reconstruction part of VMD is cancelled, so that the noise is eliminated to the maximum extent before reconstruction. Using RSVD instead of SVD, and PMI index instead of energy index during reconstruction, make the method more suitable for fault diagnosis of rolling bearings. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method are verified by simulation of motor bearing and measured data.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation Method for Fault Diagnosis of Mechanical Equipment Based on Improved Wasserstein GAN
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Most of the time the mechanical equipment is in normal operation state, which results in high imbalance between fault data and normal data. In addition, traditional signal processing methods rely heavily on expert experience, making it difficult for classification or prediction algorithms to obtain accurate results. In view of the above problem, this paper proposed a method to augment failure data for mechanical equipment diagnosis based on Wasserstein generative adversarial networks with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP). First, the multi-dimensional sensor data are converted into two-dimensional gray images in order to avoid the interference of tedious parameters preset on the model and the dependence on the professional knowledge of signal preprocessing. Based on this foundation, the gray images of the minority sample are used as the input of WGAN-GP to carry out adversarial training until the network reaches the Nash Equilibrium. Then the generated images are added to the original failure samples, reducing the imbalance of the original data samples. Finally, by calculating the structural similarity index between the generated images and the original images, the difficulty of quantitative evaluation of WGAN-GP data generated by itself is solved. Taking the accelerated bearing failure dataset as an example, the classification prediction effects of different classifiers are compared. The results of multiple experiments shown that the proposed method can more effectively improve the prediction accuracy in the case of sparse fault samples.

articleTitle: Design of Current Sensor based on Quantum Precision Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: NV color center is a kin d of point defect in diamond, which can be used in high precision magnetic field measurement. In this paper, we discuss the feasibility of using NV ensemble as a magnetic sensor to measure current. Then, the relationship between current intensity, NV color center fluorescence intensity and partial resonance is modeled and simulated. Furthermore, we analyze the influence of sensor placement distance, laser, microwave power and diamond NV color center concentration to the performance of the sensor. Therefore, this paper lays a theoretical foundation for the design and manufacture of the current sensor based on diamond NV color centers.

articleTitle: Transmission Box Condition Evaluation Based on Oil Analysis and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the assessment of the wear state of armored vehicle gearboxes is prone to misreporting and omissions, a wear state discrimination method based on oil analysis is proposed. Spectral analysis is used to periodically monitor the concentration of metal elements in the gearbox wear of armored vehicles. Use the grey prediction model to predict the short-term trend of metal element concentration. It is convenient for analysis to divide the degree of wear into three grades and establish a membership model of three. The membership degree is discriminated by the equipment concentration and trend to obtain the membership matrix, and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is obtained. Choose different weights for information fusion to get the final wear level discriminant matrix. In the level discriminant matrix, the most important level is the wear state of the gearbox of the armored vehicle. This method improves the limitation of using the concentration limit value and gradient limit value to judge the wear state of the transmission box in the past. Applied to the gearbox of armored vehicles during the test wear period, the accuracy of the proposed method is verified, which provides a new way to judge the wear state of heavy machinery.

articleTitle: The Improvement of Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Aero-engines by Classification and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: An equipment usually experiences various operating conditions and fault conditions during its lifetime. Traditionally, the state of an equipment is labeled empirically, but the empirical segments may cause the mismatch between the empirical and real labels, which reduces the prediction accuracy. In addition, if all the samples are gathered as a whole for training, the training time of a prediction model is long and the model is too generalized. To solve above problems, this paper proposes a RUL prediction method based on classification and deep learning. In this method, the random forest (RF) algorithm is used to select the appropriate training samples for the samples to be tested, and then the RUL of an equipment is predicted by a long short-term memory (LSTM) network. In this paper, the aeroengine CMAPSS dataset is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that the root mean square error (RMSE) of the predicted RULs obtained from the training samples determined by RF classification is 12.2% and 0.4% less than that of the empirical and unclassified classification respectively, which demonstrates the accuracy of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Framework and Key Technologies of Text Mining for Operation and Maintenance of Traction Power Supply Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Based on a large number of texts produced by railway traction power supply equipment during service, which is difficult to analyze and apply directly, a text information mining system framework for railway traction power supply equipment operation and maintenance is proposed. This paper covers the process of Data pre-processing, information extraction, analysis and application, and studies the key technologies of Chinese text segmentation, information extraction, status evaluation, etc. Finally, the system architecture and related key technologies are verified by actual traction power supply equipment operation and maintenance text data.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Intelligent Diagnosis System for Airborne Electronic Products Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Intelligent diagnosis methods based on big data has been widely used in the field of machinery, which plays an important role. However, the application process of intelligent diagnostic methods in airborne electronic products is relatively slow. Aiming the requirements of fault diagnosis and the typical problems in engineering practice, a diagnosis system architecture of multi-intelligence model is defined, which is realized by constructing support vector machine (SVM), deep belief network (DBN), long short-term memory neural network (LSTM), unscented particle filter (UPF) and random process (RP) models with big data. The architecture can support condition based maintenance and meet the needs of online status analysis and remaining life prediction. According to the case of airborne electronic products, software development was implemented to prove the application effect of this framework in the field of airborne electronic product maintenance.

articleTitle: State Evaluation Method of Traction Transformer Based on Variable Weight Coefficient and Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Traction transformer is one of the core equipment of traction power supply system, and its safe and stable operation are very important for this electrified railway. In this paper, a comprehensive evaluation method combining variable weight coefficient with Bayesian network is proposed based on the information generated by various states of traction transformer during the operation. Firstly, the support and confidence of each single state quantity and comprehensive state quantity are calculated by association rule algorithm based on the historical statistical data of traction transformer, and the constant weight coefficient values of each state quantity are determined; secondly, the score of comprehensive state quantity is determined by the score values and constant weight coefficient of single state quantity; then, the comprehensive state quantity and operation performance are calculated and analyzed by the method of variable weight coefficient. The overall evaluation score and the comprehensive state quantity score were calculated by variable weight coefficient. Finally, Bayesian network method is used to analyze the relationship between state levels at different times, and the final evaluation results are obtained. In this paper, the state information of traction transformer in a railway substation is used to verify the model. The evaluation method proposed in this paper can accurately evaluate the operation status of traction transformer, so that the on-site operation and maintenance personnel can timely repair and maintain the transformer with abnormal operation, so as to achieve the purpose of saving costs and reducing safety risks.

articleTitle: Accelerated Vibration Durability Test Analysis of Aviation Equipment Based on Different Fatigue Damage Spectrum Calculation Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Aiming to simulate the actual level flight vibration environment of the aviation equipment during the whole life-cycle, the calculation methods of fatigue damage spectrum based on stationary broad-band hypothesis, stationary narrow-band hypothesis and rain flow counting method are studied separately, and the synthetic acceleration spectrum in frequency domain is carried out and the process of determining vibration endurance test conditions is proposed. The field measured data of three types of flight vibration environment of typical aviation equipment is selected to calculate different types of synthetic acceleration spectrum respectively, and the basic characteristics are compared and analyzed. Thirdly, the finite element model of a certain type of airborne equipment installation frame is established to verify the influence of vibration endurance acceleration test spectrum solved by different fatigue damage spectrum calculation methods on its life. The result shows that the RMS value of the acceleration spectrum calculated by the rain flow counting method is higher than others. Based on the RMS value of rain flow counting method, the relative error between Rayleigh distribution and its RMS is 0.011 while Dirlik and its RMS is 0.0347, and Wirsching's is 0.0373. Finally, the damage results show that the fatigue damage calculated by Dirlik distribution acceleration method is closest to that by rain flow counting acceleration method, and the vibration endurance test condition based on Dirlik distribution is closest to the flight vibration environment experienced in the whole life of aviation equipment.

articleTitle: An Equivalent and Accelerated Life Test Method for Compressor Blades under Combined Loads Based on Equal Fatigue Life
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Considering combined loads due to centrifugal forces, aerodynamics, temperature and acoustics, the paper presents a method to establish and simplify the load spectrum of compressor blades based on the actual loads of aero-engines, and puts forward an equivalent method to convert centrifugal and aerodynamic loads into a vibration load with an equal fatigue life using the linear superposition principle and the average stress correction equation, and presents a calculation method of the acceleration factor, and designs a test rig to simulate the equivalent thermo-acoustic-vibration load. Thus, an accelerated life test method is provided to evaluate the serving life of blades.

articleTitle: Algebraic Signature Based Data Possession Checking Method with Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: Cloud computing has been envisioned as a next generation information technology (IT) paradigm. The risk of losing data stored with any untrustworthy service provider is the key barrier to widespread uptake of cloud computing. This paper proposes an algebraic signature based remote data possession checking (RDPC) scheme to verify the integrity of the data stored in the cloud. This scheme integrates forward error-correcting codes to enhance the data possession guarantee, which can recover the data when a small amount of file has been deleted. The scheme allows verification without the need for the auditor to compare against the original data, which reduces the communication complexity dramatically. The storage complexity of cloud user is reduced to several bytes' information. Extensive security analysis and simulation show that the proposed scheme is highly provably secure. Finally, experiment results reveal that the computation performance is effective, and bounded by disk I/O.

articleTitle: The Message From The General Chair
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Prognostics and System Health Management (PHM-2020 Jinan)
abstract: It is my great pleasure to welcome all of you to the PHM 2020 Jinan International Conference. In the past few years, this annual conference represented one of the largest gatherings of researchers and professionals to discuss most recent advancements in prognostics and system health management. This year, however, the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic and the resulting travel restrictions in many regions impose unprecedented challenges to the organization of the conference. Instead of meetings in person on site, the Conference Organization Committee has decided to shift the conference to a fully virtual one. The authors will be able to present their papers remotely via several Zoom Video channels and join discussion forums to exchange ideas with others. I hope this shift in conference mode will not affect your enthusiasm in participating in the conference and discussions.
